notes: 1-Click System Proxy toggle:: Real-time OS-level proxy redirection with cross-platform support (Linux GNOME `gsettings`, Windows registry `ProxyEnable`, macOS `networksetup`). Added status toggle in the application StatusBar. | Local working proxy feed endpoint:: HTTP GET `/proxies.txt` on the local proxy server (port 8898) returns a live newline-delimited list of verified working proxies (`host:port`). | Proxy Manager toolbar upgrade:: Real-time keyword search across host, port, country, and source; Anonymity level filter dropdown (`elite`, `anonymous`, `transparent`); bulk "Check Selected" and clipboard "Copy Selected" actions.
